tagline: Aapke doctor ki salah ki aasaan, shaant aur personalized samajh

safety.prototypeBannerBody: MedSarthi sirf synthetic data par bana ek educational prototype hai. Yeh clinically validated NAHI hai, diagnosis ya prescription nahi deta, aur doctor ki jagah nahi le sakta.
safety.prototypeFooter: Educational Prototype • Sirf Synthetic Data • Real Medical Care ke liye Validated Nahi • Har medical faisle ke liye apne doctor se zaroor poochein.
safety.emergencyNote: Agar tez seene mein dard, saans lene mein dikkat, achanak kamzori ya zyada bleeding ho, to turant 112 / 108 par call karein ya emergency hospital jayein.
safety.emergencyBannerTitle: Turant Medical Madad ki Zaroorat Hai
safety.emergencySeekCare: App ke jawab ka intezaar na karein. Turant emergency services (112 ya 108) par call karein ya nazdeeki hospital jayein.
safety.integrityPassed: Safety Check Passed — Zaroori dawaiyan, dose, timing aur warnings doctor ke note se match karte hain.
safety.integrityWarning: Safety Notice — Kripya highlight ki gayi jankari apne doctor ya pharmacist se dobara confirm kar lein.
safety.integrityBlocked: Safety Hold — Yeh explanation doctor ke original note se verify nahi ho paayi aur review ke liye roki gayi hai.
safety.integrityDisclaimer: Yeh automated check doctor ke note se zaroori baaton ka milan karta hai; yeh doctor ki salah ki jagah nahi leta.
safety.medicineProhibition: Apne doctor ya pharmacist se pooche bina koi bhi dawa shuru, band ya dose change na karein.

onboarding.step6Title: Aap MedSarthi se kis tarah samajhna chahenge?

landing.heroBadge: Doctor-Anchored Clinical Communication Bridge — Normal Chatbot Nahi Hai
landing.heroTitle: Apne doctor ki salah ko saaf, shaanti se aur apni bhasha mein samjhein.
landing.heroSubtitle: MedSarthi sirf wahi samjhata aur translate karta hai jo aapke doctor ne likha hai aur verified medical facts par based hai—unclear prescriptions par koi andaza nahi lagata, dose nahi badalta, aur text size va audio speed aapki suvidha ke anusaar rakhta hai.
landing.guestWorkspaceDesc: Instant private workspace — bina sign-up reports upload karein, sawaal poochein aur sunein

features.provenanceDesc: Doctor ke shabd, simple AI summary, verified facts aur unknown points alag-alag dikhte hain.
features.multilingualDesc: Ek tap mein bhasha badlein bina context ya medicine dose badle.
features.accessibleVoiceDesc: Bade 64px+ touch buttons, 0.75x–1.25x audio sentence highlighting, high contrast aur voice confirmation.
features.integrityGateDesc: Medicine doses, timing aur warnings check karta hai — unclear scans par koi guess nahi karta.

demo.subtitle: Instant synthetic login (zero API keys zaroori) ya 7-part judge walkthrough dekhein.
demo.patientDesc: URI + BP consultation & lab report ke saath 6-action Patient Home kholein
demo.doctorDesc: Integrity check, OCR/audio tools aur approve/share ke saath Doctor Workspace kholein

steps.step1Desc: Age-aware defaults (age 64 -> XL font + 0.75x audio), aasaan bhasha aur 'Yeh sawaal sunein' dekhein.
steps.step2Desc: Dr. Priya Mehta ka original note dekhein (URI, Hypertension, Paracetamol, Amlodipine).
steps.step3Desc: Doctor ke shabd, saral bhasha, verified medical knowledge aur unknown points alag-alag dekhein.
steps.step4Desc: English, हिन्दी aur Hinglish mein switch karein bina dose ya jankari badle.
steps.step5Title: Live Sentence Highlighting ke Saath Sunein
steps.step5Desc: 0.75x–1.25x speed par sunein line-by-line synchronized visual highlighting ke saath.
steps.step6Desc: Explain More buttons dabayein ya medical terms par tap karke diagrams dekhein.
steps.step7Title: Poochein: 'Kya iska matlab mujhe pneumonia hai?'
steps.step7Desc: Doctor ke note ke aadhar par MedSarthi ki safe Hinglish Q&A test karein.
